subject: MSA kickoff & onboarding asks — party details, templates, initial redlines
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@sprytech.com>; legal@sprytech.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MSA kickoff & onboarding asks — party details, templates, initial redlines

Hi Nora — great to meet you earlier. As discussed, looping in our contracts and billing leads to start the MSA / Order Form intake. Attached are the Redwood MSA template and a blank order form so your team can finish party/billing details and add any commercial line items.

Quick asks to keep the kickoff tight:
- Can you confirm the legal entity name you want on the MSA and the full billing address (for tax/invoice)?
- Please share a single primary billing contact + email and PO / procurement workflow (if any).
- If you have an internal party-details spreadsheet, please return it filled out (I attached a template to speed things up).
- Any required data residency, KMS/HSM, or SOC2 evidence we should plan for? If so we’ll route that to Security.

Proposed mutual action plan (tight 2-week kickoff):
1) Today — intake of party details & any initial redlines from your legal team.
2) +2 business days — Redwood legal will send a short list of clarifications and any commercial flags.
3) +5 business days — initial redline exchange.
4) Target sign by end of month (flexible depending on procurement).

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_template_20260910.docx (Redwood template), OrderForm_Template_20260910.xlsx (blank).

If there are must-have terms on your side (e.g., minimum indemnity cap, separate IP exhibits), call them out in your first reply so we can triage. Kimberly — pinging you for indemnity/breach wording and any preferred exhibit language. Karthik — FYI for commercial sequencing.

Thanks — I can hop on a 20–30 minute sync if it helps to run through the party sheet.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA kickoff & onboarding asks — party details, templates, initial redlines

Thanks Aisha — appreciated. Attaching our filled party sheet and an initial redline set so your team can see the items we typically mark up early. High level: we are comfortable with Redwood’s standard commercial structure but will likely propose a shorter liability cap, and we have a standard security addendum preference for data residency in us-west-2.

Attached: SpryTech_party_details.xlsx (filled), SpryTech_initial_redlines.docx (tracked changes).

A couple quick clarifications for Redwood legal:
- Do you offer customer-managed KMS for keys (we may require this for a subset of PII transfers)?
- For SOC2/AICPA evidence, can you share the latest reports or a link to your security package?

We’d prefer a short call early next week to walk through the redlines. Karthik — can you share a few 30-min windows?

Cheers,
Nora Patel
Head of Partnerships, SpryTech
nora@sprytech.com | 617-555-0122

Attachments: SpryTech_party_details.xlsx (attachment), SpryTech_initial_redlines.docx (attachment)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@sprytech.com>; Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA kickoff & onboarding asks — party details, templates, initial redlines

Hi Nora — thanks for the quick turn. I reviewed your initial redlines and uploaded a short questions list for triage (attached). High-level flags we’ll prioritize:
1) Indemnity & liability cap — your requested carve-outs and proposed cap will need commercial alignment (cc: Marissa for pricing impact).
2) Data residency/KMS — we can support region controls; customer-managed KMS is possible but requires a scope/ops note for Dedicated or Private deployments. Please confirm which environment SpryTech plans to use for the pilot.
3) Security evidence — I can share our SOC2 link and a custom security brief; will coordinate with Security to add any evidence items you need.

Request: can SpryTech confirm the desired go-live environment (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private) and whether there are any export control clauses we should be aware of? Those answers materially affect a few clause choices.

I propose Redwood legal provide a redline with comments within 48 business hours after we get the final party sheet and the go-live environment. If you need us to pre-clear any specific clause, flag it in the returned party sheet.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0404

Attachments: redwood_questions_for_sprytech.txt (attachment)

Subject: Re: MSA kickoff & onboarding asks — party details, templates, initial redlines

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Nora. Received the party sheet and initial redlines — Kimberly, thanks for the quick triage.

Next steps from my side:
- Schedule a 30-min contract sync early next week to walk the redlines and confirm environment (Karthik, please propose 3 windows).
- Marissa — please stand by for potential pricing impact on indemnity cap; we may need a quick pricing exception if SpryTech holds firm.
- Nora — if you can confirm pilot environment (hosted vs. dedicated) and whether you’ll require customer-managed KMS by Monday, Kimberly’s team can finalize the legal redline within 48 business hours.

I’ll set a calendar invite once Karthik posts availability. Thanks everyone — trying to keep this to a single redline exchange to speed onboarding.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
